name: EPIC 212353324
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 13.2 solar radii and 0.86 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212353324 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.169735 (16th-84th percentiles 12.427335-14.057469), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212353324 (K2 campaign 6): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4440.117188 (16th-84th percentiles 4216.835938-4671.71875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,440 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.86 solar masses and 13.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,907 K at its surface.
